style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Moscow, late 1970s, Cold War. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: logos, badges, insignia or emblems of real agencies, hammer and sickle, red stars, flags, readable text or numbers, letters on license plates, blood, faces resembling real people
